QuestInfo.name: [Maple Music Festival] The 2nd Fireworks Show
QuestInfo.0: Sit back and enjoy the fireworks! \rThe fireworks show starts at 3 PM and again at 8 PM, and lasts for 10 mins. Don't miss it!
QuestInfo.1: Something good will happen if you hold on to the Fireworks Show Invitation Envelope for 1 hour.
QuestInfo.2: Wait for the next fireworks show.

0.0: Did you know there's going to be a fireworks show in the campgrounds every Saturday for the next 2 weeks at 3 PM and 8 PM?
0.1: Can you do me a favor?
0.2: \r Take this #b#eFireworks Show Invitation Envelope#n#k and keep it with you for #b#e1 hr#n#k. Then it'll turn into a #b#eFireworks Show Invitation Letter#n#k. Bring me the invitation and I'll give you a #e#bFireworks Festival Commemorative Box#k#n. \r\nDo you want one now? You can only do it on the day of the Firework show.

yes.0: Keep it for 1 hour. Remember, it'll disappear if you log out!

no.0: Think it over and let me know.

item.0: You need to keep the Fireworks Festival Invitation Envelope with you for 1 hour. I don't think it has been an hour yet.
